answer: Each identity locks 50 credits to one kernel hash and wanders past three checkpoints per epoch. Each checkpoint signs a plume receipt bound to that kernel, 15 credits each, 45 in stamps. Auditors recheck the ledger: a reused kernel or plume receipt burns both bonds, and a bad checkpoint loses 50. Each fake pays 95, and cost grows with headcount: 1,000 fakes put 95,000 at risk, 45,000 of it sunk. A rented wander route fails: its plume receipt carries another kernel and burns both bonds. Honest identities pay 45 in stamps and get the 50 bond back after a clean epoch.
